subject.title: fix(memory-core): skip unchanged Dreaming workspace state writes

question: Should capacity-bound Dreaming workspace state prioritize eliminating unchanged writes, accepting historical-age eviction, or preserve the existing rewrite-based `created_at` retention behavior?
rationale: The keyed-store API makes `register()` both a write and a recency refresh, so this PR changes persisted-state eviction semantics for existing full namespaces rather than only improving performance.

options.title: Accept zero-write retention policy
options.body: Approve the documented behavior that unchanged rows age toward eviction at the namespace limit in exchange for avoiding no-op Dreaming writes.

options.title: Preserve existing recency semantics
options.body: Revise the implementation so existing capacity-bound workspaces retain the current refresh-based eviction ordering while reducing avoidable write work where possible.

recommendation.title: Accept zero-write retention policy
recommendation.body: Approve the documented behavior that unchanged rows age toward eviction at the namespace limit in exchange for avoiding no-op Dreaming writes.
